notes.title: New Horde mode released !
notes.content:
[h1]Here is the first new mode added :D[/h1]
Horde mode !

This mode completely changes the way the game is played while still keeping the base gameplay !
[list]
    [*]Fight off endless waves of ghosts
    [*]Score points by killing the most ghosts
    [*]Make your opponents lose tons of points by ejecting them out of the arena
[/list]

[h1]ALSO ![/h1]
It can be played solo or multi ! 
Finally you can enjoy the game alone ;)

<3
